distribution: Yizhang, Hunan; abroad, recorded from Bangladesh.
soldier: Head yellowish brown, the nasus slightly darker than the head, pale reddish brown, antennae pale brown, pronotum yellow, legs and abdomen yellowish white. Head hairs sparse but with many fine hairs, two long hairs on each of the posterior half of the head and slightly behind the base of the nasus, the nasus covered with microchaetae and bearing a few long hairs at its tip; the margin of the pronotum with sparse fine hairs, the disc bare. Head pear-shaped, the posterolateral margins convex outwards, slightly depressed at the antennal sockets, the posterior margin concave in the middle; in profile a low swelling at the base of the nasus. Nasus columnar, mandibles without a spine. Antennae with 13 segments, the third slightly longer than the second. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin with a notch in the middle, the posterior margin arched. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi with 4 segments.
